content: Iymiren n temmurt
Issiweř SIDI ak-d Musa, inna:
“Umur ayt n Israil uca ini asen: ‘Xmi ɣa tadfem tammurt n Kenɛan, xenni ta d tammurt i d awem ɣa yiřin d řwart, tammurt n Kenɛan ak-d iymiren nnes ad tiři ammu:
Jjihet n ljanub ad ɣarwem tiři zi řexřa n Ṣin ař aymir n Idum uca aymir n ljanub ad ɣarwem yiři zi ṭṭarf aneggaru n Řebḥar Ameǧaḥ di ccarq
uca aymir ad imeyyeř zi ljanub ɣar Tsunta n Tɣarḍmiwin uca ad iɛdu ɣar Ṣin uca ṭṭrufa nnes ad dd-awḍen jjihet n ljanub n Qadac-Barniɛ uca ad iɛdu ɣar Ḥaṣar-Addar uca ad iẓwa ɣar Aṣmun.
Ad inneḍ weymir zi Aṣmun ɣar Teɣzart n Miṣra uca ṭṭrufa nnes ad awḍen ař řebḥar.
Uca aymir n řɣarb ad awem yiři Řebḥar Ameqqran. Wa ad awem yiři d aymir n řɣarb.”
Wa ad awem yiři d aymir n ccamal: ad t tarcmem i yixef nwem zeg Řebḥar Ameqqran ař adrar n Hur.
Zeg wedrar n Hur ad t tarcmem ař mani ɣa tawḍed ɣar Ḥamat uca ṭṭrufa n weymir ad awḍen ař Ṣadad.
Ad yeɛdu weymir ař Zifrun uca ṭṭrufa nnes ad awḍen ař Ḥaṣar-Ɛinan. Wa ad awem yiři d aymir n ccamal.
Ad tarcmem aymir nwem n ccarq zi Ḥaṣar-Ɛinan ɣar Cafam
uca ad dd-ihwa weymir zi Cfam ař Ribla, ccarq n Ɛayn. Xenni ad dd-ihwa weymir ɛad ktar uca ad imun ak-d tma n ccarq n Řebḥar n Kinnarat.
Xenni ad dd-ihwa weymir ɣar L’Urdun uca ṭṭrufa nnes ad awḍen ař Řebḥar Ameǧaḥ. Ta ad awem tiři d tammurt ak-d iymiren nnes i d as dd-innḍen.”
Uca Musa yumur ayt n Israil, inna: “Ta d tammurt nni i ɣa tebḍam jar awem s tqedduḥt, tenni x yumur SIDI ad temmewc i tesɛa n tqebbař u i wezyen n teqbič n Manassa.

Minzi taqbič n ayt n Rubin tᵉttwasettef ɛlaḥsab taddart n ibabaten nsen u taqbič n Jad tᵉttwasettef ɛlaḥṣab taddart n ibabaten nsen, aqa nitni ṭṭfen ɛad tasɣart nsen, u azyen n teqbič n Manassa tᵉṭṭef uřa d nettat tasɣart nnes n řwart.
Tnayen n tqebbař d wezyen aqa ṭṭfent řwart nsent ɣar ujemmaḍ n L’Urdun, zi Ariḥa ɣar ccarq ɣar manis dd-tneqqar tfuct.”
Issiweř SIDI ak-d Musa, inna:
“Ina d ismawen n yeryazen inni i ɣa ibḍan tammurt jar awem: Akehhan Aliɛazar d Yacuwa, mmis n Nun.
Ad teksim ɛawed ijj n řḥakem zi kuř taqbič maḥend ad tebḍam tammurt.
Ina d ismawen n yeryazen: i teqbič n Yahuda, Kalib, mmis n Yafunni
i teqbič n ayt n Cimɛun, Cimuwil, mmis n Ɛammihud,
i teqbič n Binyamin, Ilidad, mmis n Kaslun,
i teqbič n ayt n Dan, řḥakem Buqqi, mmis n Yujli,
i teqbič n ayt n Yusuf: i teqbič n ayt n Manassa, řḥakem Ḥanniyil, mmis n Ifud,
i teqbič n ayt n Ifrayim, řḥakem Qimuyil, mmis n Cifṭan,
i teqbič n ayt n Zabulun, řḥakem Iliṣafan, mmis n Farnax,
i teqbič n ayt n Issakar, řḥakem Falṭiyil, mmis n Ɛazzan,
i teqbič n ayt n Acir, řḥakem Axihud, mmis n Calumi,
i teqbič n ayt n Naftali, řḥakem Fadahyil, mmis n Ɛammihud.”
Ina d inni x yumur SIDI ad bḍan řwart i ayt n Israil di temmurt n Kenɛan.

footnotes.text: Řebḥar Ameqqran- niɣ ‘Ill Ameqqran’. Řebḥar-a qqaren as di Arif ‘Řebḥar Ameẓyan’, uca isem nnes n jdid aqa-t ‘Ill Agrakal’.
